visual_synopsis: Two village men are filmed in a scruffy farmstead and mostly talk straight to camera in alternating shots: a long-haired man in a beaded headband, fleece jacket and heavy gold pendant sits in a shed hung with fishing nets and drying herbs, fiddling with a cord and later squinting at a glass jar, while a mustached man in a striped polo speaks from the yard under a leaning sheet-metal roof and is seen stooping in a tall grass field. Nothing more physical happens; the tape is badly colour-damaged with magenta and green blocks, so the point of the sketch is not readable from the picture.
